001package io.github.ai4ci.config.setup;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004
005import org.jgrapht.graph.DefaultEdge;
006import org.jgrapht.graph.SimpleGraph;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonIgnore;
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonSubTypes;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonSubTypes.Type;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo.Id;
013import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.OptBoolean;
014
015import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Abstraction;
016import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
017
018/**
019 * Abstract configuration for network generation used during model setup.
020 *
021 * <p>
022 * Concrete implementations provide parameters for specific graph generation
023 * algorithms (for example Erdos‑Reyni, Watts‑Strogatz and Barabasi‑Albert). The
024 * configuration objects are consumed by the model builder during the
025 * {@code setupOutbreak} stage to create the social network used by the
026 * simulation.
027 *
028 * <p>
029 * Extension guidance: to add a new network type implement a new configuration
030 * class and add it to the Jackson polymorphic mapping above (or register it
031 * with your object mapper). Keep generation logic in the configuration's
032 * {@link #generateGraph} method so the builder can remain generic.
033 * </p>
034 *
035 * @author Rob Challen
036 */
037@JsonTypeInfo(
038                use = Id.NAME,
039                requireTypeIdForSubtypes = OptBoolean.TRUE
040)
041@JsonSubTypes(
042        { @Type(value = ImmutableWattsStrogatzConfiguration.class),
043                        @Type(value = ImmutableErdosReyniConfiguration.class),
044                        @Type(value = ImmutableBarabasiAlbertConfiguration.class) }
045)
046public interface NetworkConfiguration
047                extends Serializable, Abstraction.Described {
048
049        /**
050         * Generate a social network graph according to the concrete configuration
051         * parameters.
052         *
053         * <p>
054         * Builders pass an empty {@link SimpleGraph} and expect the method to
055         * populate it with nodes and edges. Implementations should add nodes and
056         * edges deterministically from the configuration values so results can be
057         * reproduced when the same seed is used.
058         *
059         * @param socialNetwork mutable graph to populate with nodes and edges
060         */
061        @JsonIgnore
062        void generateGraph(SimpleGraph<Person, DefaultEdge> socialNetwork);
063
064        /**
065         * Model parameter: target average degree for the generated network.
066         *
067         * @return the average number of social network contacts
068         */
069        Integer getNetworkDegree();
070
071        /**
072         * Model parameter: number of agents to generate in the network.
073         *
074         * @return the number of agents in the model
075         */
076        Integer getNetworkSize();
077
078}
